review_notes: Corrected: the accepted file had the source ids of the vocative and the question rotated against their own surfaces — s005 (הֲ) was labelled Son, s006 (רָאִיתָ) of man, s007 (בֶן) hast, s008 (אָדָם) thou seen. The English placement and the unit notes were right; the ids were reassigned to the morphemes that carry them, s005 taking hast, s006 thou seen, s007 Son and s008 of man.

The interrogative particle takes the fronted hast under rule 17, leaving thou seen to the verb; this differs from 8.6, where the ASV marks the question by inversion alone and the particle is unrepresented.
אֵין here takes only the negation not: the ASV writes no presentative frame for this clause, and rule 50 heads the existential on the negation word in either case.
After the correction all 33 source and 42 target ids remain partitioned exactly once.
